extracted.name: Savory Mango Guacamole
extracted.description: This mango guacamole puts a twist on the traditional ingredients for a sweet and savory flavor. Try it on chips or slather it on any type of sandwich.
instruction_lines: Mash avocados in a medium bowl to a lumpy consistency. Mix in onion, mango, lime juice, garlic, salt, and cilantro.
